verdict.rationale: Codegen's own agents generate insights and suggestions from user-owned data. A documented endpoint analyzes sandbox setup logs to identify errors, explain what went wrong and suggest fixes, and its agents review PRs, summarize changes and suggest edits. These insights are tied to code and logs, delivered via API or GitHub comments rather than a general in-product insights experience. Missing for 10: general AI insights over a user's broader data, an in-product UI surface for insights, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote:
This endpoint creates an AI agent that will analyze the setup logs from a sandbox,
identify any errors, provide insights about what went wrong, and suggest potential
solutions.
Review PRs, suggest changes, comment on issues
